title: The Weather of the fourth floor walk-up
author: E. M. Marchetti
blurb: Kestrel Galloway, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
